notes:
Medication & sales update
Medication: type a name (or a nickname) that's on your reference sheet and the Add form fills itself in: dose, how it's taken, schedule, and the dose steps by week. Tick or untick "Use the sheet's dose steps" before saving.
The reference sheet now reads more ways of writing steps (weeks, months, days, "first 4 weeks… then…", several steps on one line) and shows how the app reads the Dosage text while you edit it. Anything it can't read is flagged so you can fix it once.
Dose steps can now be counted in days as well as weeks (like "days 1-4: 0.25 mg, days 5-21: 0.5 mg"). The plan card shows today's dose and when it changes. Existing week-based plans carry over unchanged.
Prices: the sale is now a bigger 🏷 tag. Tap it to see each offer on its own line, copy a promo code, or open the page. Long sale text is trimmed at a word instead of mid-word.
